identity: Astronomer and university teacher · United States · 1863–1941
title: Annie Jump Cannon's birth chart
metaDescription: Annie Jump Cannon's chart, computed from a sourced birth date: Sun at 19.2° Sagittarius. Birth time unknown, so no houses or rising sign.
lede: Four of the nine placements whose signs are settled fall in fixed signs, the widest weighting the unknown hour leaves certain. The fixed signs are the scheme’s ballast — mid-season, fully committed, expensive to turn.

blocks.title: Where the Sun actually stood
blocks.text: At noon on that date the Sun stood at 19.2° Sagittarius, inside the second decan (10°–20°), whose traditional sub-ruler is Mars. The decan is the older, finer division — it is what the sign looks like once you stop rounding it to thirty degrees.

blocks.title: Closer to the ground
blocks.text: For the fast movers, Mercury was at 24.6° Sagittarius, Venus was at 2.4° Scorpio, Mars was at 26.3° Scorpio. Read together: thought that arrives already in motion; attraction that works by atmosphere; effort that surges when it matters.

blocks.title: The angles that hold
blocks.text: Closest first: Mercury to Uranus, an opposition with 1.4° of slack. An opposition puts two needs on opposite shores of the same water. Neither drowns; neither gets the whole beach. Behind it, the Sun sextile Saturn at 3.0°, and the Sun opposition Uranus at 4.0° — both still well inside the orbs this site uses. The unknown hour cannot unmake any of this: every aspect named survived all twenty-five samples of the day.

blocks.title: Figures in the geometry
blocks.text: The Moon makes no major aspect that survives the day; the old reading gives such a planet autonomy — it acts alone, sometimes loudly.

blocks.title: The classical map
blocks.text: Read against the old dignities, four placements stand out. Mercury in Sagittarius at 24.6° is in detriment — the planet opposite its home, working against the grain; Venus in Scorpio at 2.4° is in detriment; Mars in Scorpio at 26.3° is in domicile — the planet in its own sign, running on home rules; Saturn in Libra at 16.2° is in exaltation — the tradition’s honoured-guest placement, working at its best. The table describes circumstance rather than quality — a planet in detriment is inconvenienced, not diminished.

blocks.title: The shape of the whole
blocks.text: Counting only the 9 placements whose signs hold for the whole day, the chart runs 3 fire, 3 water, 2 air, 1 earth by element and 4 fixed, 3 mutable, 2 cardinal by modality. A fire-weighted chart runs hot at the start line — initiative is its native language. Uranus, Neptune and Pluto were retrograde — apparent retreat against the stars, which the old reading takes as a function working from the inside first.

blocks.title: The Moon is genuinely open
blocks.text: The Moon crossed from Sagittarius into Capricorn during that day at the birthplace, travelling 14.8° between one midnight and the next. A birth time would settle it in a second; there isn’t one. So the Moon stays unnamed here — the alternative is a guess wearing the clothes of a fact.
